findings.summary: AI-N28 repair round, stage 2: ESP32 3-class retrained on the dcm x1000 grid with distillation alpha 0.75 (same recipe, teacher and split as 2026-11-04_run01). Candidate only; not promoted; the registry is unchanged. Its int8 variant V11 (calibration C2, per-tensor weights) was SELECTED on validation and tested once: DOES NOT MEET the criterion (E3 normal recall 0.994 -> 0.687, abstention +19 points; E1 macro-F1 -1.7).
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (dcm x1000 grid); no real-machine validation exists.
3 classes (inner_race, normal, outer_race): a ball or cage fault is assigned to one of the 3 known classes; no OOD method catches it (AI-N13).
